__doc: Synthetic example-UUID registry — the publish-surface leak gate's allowlist.
Every real-shape UUID in this repository MUST be listed here, or
scripts/verify-example-ids.mjs fails CI and prepublish. To add an example id:
mint a fresh random UUID (uuidgen), confirm it references no real system,
register it with a one-line use note. NEVER copy an identifier out of a real
request, response, webhook delivery, or operator fixture flow. This repo was
recreated 2026-06-11 from a swept snapshot precisely so its history starts
